edges: Leibniz worked in an intellectual world in which Llullian combinatorics were known; avoid treating the systems as identical.
Universal symbolic calculation is an antecedent of algebraic logic.
Shannon explicitly applied Boolean algebra to switching networks.
Formalized logic makes mechanical decidability an exact question.
The Entscheidungsproblem is explicit in Turing's title and purpose.
Church offered lambda-definability as a characterization of effective calculability.
Turing supplied an independent machine analysis.
Universal-machine construction appears in Turing's framework.
Bayes/Price work is explicitly probabilistic inference from evidence.
Markov generalizes probability to dependent sequences.
HMMs add latent state and observations to Markov dynamics.
MDPs add actions/rewards to Markovian state evolution.
EM is explicitly a likelihood procedure for incomplete/latent data.
Bayesian networks computationalize structured probabilistic inference.
Causal semantics add interventions and structural claims beyond observational factorization.
Feedback is a core organizing idea of cybernetics.
Physiological regulation supplies the biological half of the animal/machine analogy.
State estimation becomes a central feedback-control component.
Bellman recursion solves sequential state-based decision problems.
TD uses bootstrapped value targets analogous to sampled Bellman backups.
Q-learning is a TD control algorithm over state-action values.
Schultz, Dayan and Montague explicitly linked dopamine to prediction-error learning.
Policy optimization is a common RLHF component.
Neural-cell thinking makes a neuron-like computational unit possible, though the model is radically simplified.
Perceptron systems add adaptive trainability to neuron-like threshold processing.
Correlation-based associative memory connects the traditions.
STDP provides a precise timing-sensitive biological elaboration of Hebbian association.
Neural-network backprop is reverse differentiation specialized to compositional networks.
Backprop extends error-driven learning to networks with hidden nonlinear layers.
Backprop-trained representations were central to the PDP connectionist revival.
Hierarchical receptive fields and tolerance mechanisms precede trainable CNNs.
Backprop makes convolutional hierarchies end-to-end trainable.
LSTM changes recurrent memory dynamics through gating.
Evolutionary operators explicitly abstract biological evolution.
Cellular automata provide model worlds for emergence and synthetic life.
Ecological perception emphasizes agent-relative action possibilities.
Situated closed-loop action extends cybernetic regulatory thinking.
Recursive probabilistic state estimation is foundational to early SLAM formulations.
Contextual distribution becomes geometric statistical representation.
Learned embeddings continue the continuous distributional representation tradition.
Embeddings are a direct instance of distributed representation.
Foundation models are useful precisely because representations transfer and adapt.
Next-token targets are produced from raw sequences themselves.
Transformer replaces recurrent sequence computation with stacked attention-centered blocks.
Residual connections are explicit components of Transformer layers.
GPT-style models use causal Transformer stacks.
GPT-3 demonstrated few-shot adaptation through context at large scale.
Modern language-model scaling studies were largely conducted on Transformer models.
Predictable scale-performance relations influence training allocation and model strategy.
Transformer architectures dominate early language foundation-model development.
CLIP directly uses contrastive learning over matched image-text pairs.
VAEs optimize a variational Bayesian objective.
GAN training is posed as a two-player minimax game.
Latent diffusion performs diffusion in a learned compressed representation.

CoT becomes especially effective in sufficiently large pretrained models.
ReAct explicitly interleaves reasoning traces with actions.
Large-scale vision-language alignment becomes a major ingredient of later multimodal systems.
Longer structured inference traces are one route to spending more inference computation.
